description: Implementation of the SensorBase class for sensor device management in Android, including device opening, closing, input device handling, and timestamp retrieval.

classes.name: SensorBase
classes.description: A class managing sensor device file descriptors, input device handling, and timestamping.

methods.name: SensorBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing device and data names, opening input if data_name is provided.

methods.name: ~SensorBase
methods.description: Destructor closing open device and data file descriptors.

methods.name: open_device
methods.description: Opens the sensor device file if not already open.

methods.name: close_device
methods.description: Closes the sensor device file if open.

methods.name: getFd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor for the device or input data.

methods.name: setDelay
methods.description: Stub method for setting sensor delay, returns 0.

methods.name: hasPendingEvents
methods.description: Stub method indicating no pending events, returns false.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns current monotonic timestamp in nanoseconds.

methods.name: openInput
methods.description: Searches /dev/input for an input device matching inputName and returns its file descriptor.
